item.title: St. Scholastica Football Hires Joe Gatz as Team’s New Offensive Coordinator
item.description: DULUTH, Minn.- The St. Scholastica Saints have a new offensive coordinator. Former Northern Michigan offensive line coach Joe Gatz has recently joined the team. He led a Wildcats line that was 28th in the nation for rushing attack and 14th for fewest sacks allowed. Gatz takes over for Justin Sinz, who took a job with Abilene Christian. Categories: College, Sports
